svg.title: AMB3R-Conditioned Trajectory-Guided Heatmap Head
svg.desc: A causal AMB3R pose stream and a frozen Qwen visual stream feed a learned heatmap head. Per-history trajectory-guided fusion predicts visibility and coarse-to-fine heatmaps for front, right, back, and left directions. Ground-truth geometry is used only for training labels.
svg.text: model pose input during VO adaptation + inference
The full frozen Qwen2.5-VL still runs in System-2.
ONE ENCODED PAIR PER HISTORY FRAME
R/B/L are learned slots with pooled Front context
FINE DECODER FROZEN IN VO ADAPT
same history slots · fixed direction order
raw heatmap / visibility logits + age / mask
four-view geometry available only as labels
Two-stage learning: train/adapt the heatmap head, then freeze it while training the tokenizer and NextDiT control adapters.
